mentions.name: Small JavaScript games in TIC-80
mentions.description: Small games written in JavaScript for the TIC-80 fantasy console, built as a way to learn JavaScript better and practice retro game development, including making sound effects and music with the console's built-in tools.
mentions.source_excerpt: I realize TIC-80 is basically the same but allows me to use other languages, so I’m trying to write small games using JS.
